certificate: URT icosahedral continuum-stencil closure and lattice obstruction

fourth_order_symbol_theorem.expansion: chi(k)=1-(ell^2/2) M2_ij k_i k_j+(ell^4/24) M4_ijkl k_i k_j k_k k_l+O(|k|^6)
fourth_order_symbol_theorem.geometric_closure: Together with the antipodal theorem, the exact projective-design and conference-matrix proof forces the unique regular icosahedron up to O(3), sign choices and relabeling.
fourth_order_symbol_theorem.status: E conditional on a self-adjoint equal-shell propagator and fourth-order isotropy
fourth_order_symbol_theorem.weight_scope: Rotational isotropy alone leaves any 0<w<=1/12 with w0=1-12w; it fixes the geometry but not the moving/rest weights.

gaussian_heat_jet_closure.premise_precision: The numerical weights require Gaussian fourth-cumulant matching, not rotational invariance or pressure isotropy alone.
gaussian_heat_jet_closure.status: E conditional on fourth-order Gaussian/Maxwellian matching

propagator.characteristic_symbol: chi(k)=w0+sum_a w_a exp(i ell n_a dot k)
propagator.definition: (Tf)(x)=w0 f(x)+sum_a w_a f(x+ell n_a), with twelve distinct unit n_a

self_adjointness_theorem.adjoint_kernel: T^* has weight w_{-v} on translation v
self_adjointness_theorem.consequence: T=T^* iff w_v=w_{-v}.  With twelve distinct equal positive moving weights, the support is exactly six antipodal pairs.

sixth_order_boundary.consequence: The first direction-dependent truncation error occurs at O(|k|^6); the finite stencil is not an exactly rotation-invariant continuum kernel.
sixth_order_boundary.statement: The icosahedral shell is isotropic through degree five but not six.

three_dimensional_lattice_obstruction.A4_scope: The four-dimensional A4 root lattice can carry order-five symmetry, but the project has not supplied a local projection/streaming map whose twelve three-dimensional velocities land exactly on sites.
three_dimensional_lattice_obstruction.consequence: No rank-three Bravais lattice is invariant under full icosahedral symmetry.  Exact local site-to-site streaming of this shell requires an off-lattice rule, a quasicrystal/cut-and-project structure, or an explicit higher-dimensional lift.
three_dimensional_lattice_obstruction.proof: If a rank-three Bravais lattice admitted a nontrivial order-five rotation R, a lattice basis would represent R in GL(3,Z), so Tr R would be an integer.  A real three-dimensional order-five rotation has eigenvalues 1,zeta5,zeta5^-1 (or their square) and trace phi or 1-phi, neither an integer.
three_dimensional_lattice_obstruction.status: E for the rank-three obstruction; U for the required bridge

verdict.advance: The former antipodality and moment assumptions are now derived from a single explicit continuum-stencil requirement.  The irreducible remaining choices are that requirement itself and its missing local higher-dimensional/off-lattice realization.
verdict.regular_icosahedral_geometry: E conditional on self-adjoint equal-shell propagation and fourth-order rotational isotropy
verdict.weights_2_over_5_and_1_over_20: E conditional on the stronger fourth-order Gaussian heat-jet premise
